text:
Slow WhatsApp replies are the most expensive leak in a small business. And almost nobody measures it.

Quick math for a clinic (use your own numbers):
40 WhatsApp enquiries a month
₹3,000 average patient value
Lose just 10 of them to a faster competitor → ₹30,000 a month. ₹3.6 lakh a year.

No ad budget fixes that. A reply system does.

Do this today. 10 minutes, free:
1. WhatsApp Business → Business tools → turn ON Greeting message and Away message
2. Greeting: "Hi! Thanks for messaging [Business]. Tell us what you need, we reply within 15 minutes. Prices & timings: [link]"
3. Quick replies: save your 5 most-asked answers as /price, /timing, /location, /offer, /book

Then test it tonight: message your own business number from a friend's phone.
How many minutes did the reply take?

Want this fixed in your business? WhatsApp me: +91 98131 36114
